in_sanskrit.name: Krithik
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's creation
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Krithik एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Krithik is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kritha' which means 'God's creation'. In Hindu mythology, Krithik is a name given to the constellation Pleiades, also known as 'Mrigasira'. The seven stars in this constellation are believed to represent the seven celestial nymphs who were the children of the sage Kashyapa and his wife, Aditi. Krithik is a name of immense spiritual significance and is often associated with creation, fertility, and abundance.
